profile_text.body:
Asana is a publicly traded work and project management software company (Nasdaq: ASAN, CIK 0001477720) that describes itself as providing work management software for teams and AI agents, with tools to plan, automate, and execute workflows. Its platform is positioned around what the company calls the Work Graph, a shared context layer that its AI components draw on to carry task history, feedback, and preferences across workflows.

Asana's primary AI offering, tracked here as Asana AI, sits within the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and encompasses goal tracking, team productivity analytics, and data residency options. The company describes a suite it calls Agentic Work Management, which brings together pre-built AI agents it terms AI Teammates, a builder called AI Studio, a dashboard product called Asana Dash, and integration layers via MCP and AI Connectors. The company describes the AI Teammates as agents that operate inside real workflows with shared memory and governance, and it also allows teams to create custom AI Teammates from their collective expertise.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Asana at this time.
